title: Evaluating and Mitigating Linguistic Discrimination in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Translating harmful queries (AdvBench dataset) and benign queries (Natural Questions dataset) into 74 different languages, querying multiple LLMs, and comparing the consistency of the models' safety (using a Language Jailbreak Rate metric) and response quality (using F1-scores of answers translated back to English) across high-resource and low-resource languages.
